dialect: UTF-8 without a byte-order mark; LF line endings.
RFC 4180 quoting: fields containing commas, quotes or newlines are wrapped in double quotes, inner quotes doubled.
One header row whose names and order equal the column tables below; a file may leave out the optional trailing columns marked as such.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Timestamps (none in v1) would be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ in UTC.
Numbers use a dot decimal separator, no thousands separators; money and quantities carry at most 12 integer and 3 fractional digits (trailing fractional zeros do not count).
Booleans are the literals true and false.
An empty field means NULL; required columns must not be empty.
Files are loaded in the order listed below so every reference resolves; files of optional entities may be absent.
demand_history is split into monthly parts named YYYY-MM.csv under a demand_history/ folder; a single demand_history.csv with the same header is also accepted.
manifest.json lists every file with its row count and sha256 and records the generator version, seed and window.

code.description: code: 1-64 characters, letters, digits, . _ and -, starting with a letter or digit

item_code.description: part number: 1-64 characters, letters, digits, . _ - and /, starting with a letter or digit

decimal.description: decimal number with a dot separator

money.description: decimal amount in the row's currency, dot separator

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (two capital letters)

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays 1-7 (1 = Monday) joined by ; (for example 5;6), distinct, at most 6; empty for none

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, for example Asia/Riyadh

entities.name: work_calendars
entities.description: Working-day calendars: weekend days and whether a country's public holidays apply. Locations and suppliers without a calendar use their country's default.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Country whose public holidays apply (sector all).

columns.name: observe_public_holidays
columns.description: The country's public holidays are non-working days (needs country_code).

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: false for calendars no longer used.

entities.name: holiday_overrides
entities.description: Calendar exceptions for one country (every location and supplier there without its own calendar) or one work calendar: closure adds non-working days, working_day cancels a public holiday or weekend day.

row_rules.description: Exactly one of `country_code` and `work_calendar_code` is set.
An override covers at most 366 days.

set_rules.description: Overrides of one scope do not overlap (within the file and with stored overrides it does not replace).

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Country scope; empty when work_calendar_code is set.

columns.name: work_calendar_code
columns.description: Calendar scope; empty when country_code is set.

columns.name: ends_on
columns.description: Last day (on or after starts_on, at most 366 days in all).

columns.name: kind
columns.description: closure: non-working days; working_day: working days despite a holiday or weekend.

entities.name: locations
entities.description: Warehouses, regional hubs and branches of the network.

row_rules.description: A location is not its own parent.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Country of the location (drives weekends and holidays).

columns.name: parent_location_code
columns.description: Default replenishment source; empty for the central warehouse.

columns.name: work_calendar_code
columns.description: Work calendar; empty for the country default (weekends and public holidays).

entities.name: network_links
entities.description: Transfer lanes between locations: lead times in calendar days and the freight cost per unit or per shipment. One lane per ordered pair.

row_rules.description: `freight_basis` none has no cost and no currency; any other basis needs both.

columns.name: lead_time_days_p50
columns.description: Typical transfer lead time in calendar days.

columns.name: lead_time_days_p90
columns.description: Slow (90th percentile) lead time in calendar days.

columns.name: freight_cost
columns.description: Freight cost; empty when freight_basis is none.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Currency of freight_cost; empty when freight_basis is none.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: false for lanes no longer used.

entities.name: brands
entities.description: Makes and aftermarket brands that items belong to.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: false for brands no longer sold.

row_rules.description: `discontinued_on` is on or after `introduced_on`; a file may map either one, and the other keeps its stored value.

columns.name: introduced_on
columns.description: First day the item was available.

columns.name: discontinued_on
columns.description: Last day the item was available.

entities.name: item_supersessions
entities.description: Part replacements: demand for the predecessor moves to the successor from effective_on. One successor per predecessor.

row_rules.description: An item does not supersede itself.

set_rules.description: Supersession chains never form a cycle.

columns.name: effective_on
columns.description: First day the successor replaces the predecessor.

columns.name: quantity_factor
columns.description: Units of successor per unit of predecessor (1 unless the pack changes).

entities.name: item_interchanges
entities.description: Interchangeable parts. one_way: the alternate may be issued when the item is requested, never the reverse; two_way: both directions. One row per unordered pair; a reversed pair replaces the stored orientation when the file maps direction (otherwise the stored orientation and direction are kept).

columns.name: alternate_item_code
columns.description: Item that may be issued instead.

columns.name: priority
columns.description: Order in which alternates are tried (1 first).

entities.name: suppliers
entities.description: Suppliers and their typical lead times.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Country the supplier ships from (any ISO code).

columns.name: lead_time_days_p50
columns.description: Typical lead time in calendar days.

columns.name: lead_time_days_p90
columns.description: Slow lead time (90th percentile) in calendar days.

columns.name: work_calendar_code
columns.description: Work calendar; empty for the country default (weekends and public holidays).

entities.name: supplier_items
entities.description: What each supplier sells: lead time, minimum order quantity, pack size and price.

row_rules.description: `lead_time_days_p90` is empty or at least `lead_time_days`; a file may map either one, and the other keeps its stored value.

set_rules.description: At most one preferred supplier per item in the file; importing a preferred row clears the item's other preferred row.

columns.name: lead_time_days
columns.description: Planning lead time in calendar days.

columns.name: lead_time_days_p90
columns.description: Slow lead time in calendar days.

columns.name: is_preferred
columns.description: Preferred source for the item (at most one per item).

entities.name: fx_rates
entities.description: Exchange rates: 1 from_currency = rate to_currency from valid_from until the next row of the pair. One row per unordered pair and date; a reversed pair replaces the stored orientation when the file maps rate (otherwise the stored orientation and rate are kept).

columns.name: rate
columns.description: Units of to_currency per unit of from_currency.

entities.name: demand_history
entities.description: Daily demand per item and location. Only days with demand or lost sales appear; a missing day means zero.

row_rules.description: `demand_date` falls in a month the database keeps demand for and is at most tomorrow.

entities.name: stock_snapshots
entities.description: Daily stock observations. Missing observations are unknown, not zero. The dashboard uses the latest observation on or before its reporting day for each item and location. Available stock is quantity minus allocated_quantity; allocations may exceed stock.

entities.name: open_orders
entities.description: Outstanding inbound order lines. Quantity is the remaining open quantity, not the original ordered quantity. Set it to zero or status to closed/canceled to retire a line; receipts do not automatically change orders or stock.

columns.name: line_code
columns.description: External line reference, unique within the order.

entities.name: receipts
entities.description: Inbound receipt lines, keyed by external receipt and line references. Corrections replace a line. Importing a receipt never increments a stock snapshot or decrements an open order; each feed remains authoritative.

columns.name: line_code
columns.description: External line reference, unique within the receipt.
